quiz.title: Concepts of Algorithmic Specification
quiz.description: A deep dive into the theoretical and logical foundations of Chapter 1.

questions.question_text: In the 'Contract' model of software, what does the specification primarily define?
questions.option_b: What the code does, not how it does it
questions.option_d: The specific compiler to be used

questions.question_text: What is the logical status of a post-condition if the pre-condition was false at start?
questions.option_c: It is irrelevant; the contract is void
questions.option_d: It must be checked by the compiler

questions.question_text: Which concept allows a post-condition to refer to values from the starting state?
questions.hint: They 'haunt' the final state with initial values.

questions.question_text: What does 'Partial Correctness' specifically ignore?
questions.hint: It only cares about the result *if* it finishes.
